name: r8_relabel_repair_072
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p=Path.cwd();f='src/URMatchingRelabel.lean';s=(p/f).read_text().replace('hi, Finset.image_id]','hi]
  ext x
  simp').replace('  rw [mappedEdges_inverse e.symm] at hh
  exact hh','  have hqi : mappedEdges e (mappedEdges e.symm Q) = Q := by
    simpa only [Equiv.symm_symm] using mappedEdges_inverse e.symm Q
  exact hqi.symm.trans hh');r=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3','-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),f],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
